records.prompt: Create one Russian Napoleonic circa 1812 CUIRASSIER cavalry idle sprite, single rider on horse, transparent background. Reference image supplies ONLY the smooth painted strategy-game style, compact natural horse anatomy, and directly overhead camera. Replace all medieval equipment and bow. Near vertical overhead orthographic viewpoint: see helmet crown, shoulder tops and horse back, torso strongly foreshortened, no face visible. Facing screen bottom, tail at top. Rider has 1808-style black lacquered leather helmet with brass front plate and black horsehair crest running along crown; black-painted iron cuirass breast/back plates secured by brass-scaled shoulder straps; white wool short uniform jacket with restrained red collar/cuffs, white or pale gray riding trousers, tall black leather riding boots, white gloves. No mail, pauldrons, fur trim, shield, bow or lance. Right hand SCREEN LEFT holds a STRAIGHT cavalry broadsword with brass basket guard, relaxed upright at rest alongside right shoulder, not thrusting; left hand SCREEN RIGHT holds reins. Sword is straight broad steel blade not curved saber, visible complete within frame. Compact sturdy bay horse with black mane/tail, normal narrow head and clear paired ears, natural saddle and stirrups, brown leather harness, muted dark red saddlecloth with thin pale edging, period saddle roll behind rider. Horse has NO armor. Correct visible rump separate above rider, neck/head below rider, separate four legs, horse smaller relative to rider, retain realistic structure. Calm stationary pose. Strong readable white sleeves versus black breastplate silhouette. Match polished warm painterly game finish of reference; no grainy texture, no heavy contour outlines or glow, no ground shadow, no scenery, no text. Entire unit fully inside generous transparent margins. Single portrait idle frame.
